text:
alex.k: quick heads-up — ran eval on v2-ranker with new sampleframe, ndcg down ~1.8%. anyone else see this?
sara: saw similar on holdout, mrr barely changed. share numbers?
alex.k: short run: N=10k, ndcg@10: baseline 0.421 -> v2 0.413, mrr@10 0.219 -> 0.218
mike: thanks. what changed in sampleframe?
alex.k: switched to stratified sampling by session_time + doc_len, also normalized doc layout (strip html -> plain text). suspect doc formatting
julia: did you quantize before run? int8 PTQ? :thinking_face:
alex.k: yes, v2-int8-ptq on dev cluster. float32 baseline in dedicated pool.
sara: can you paste eval command?
alex.k: ```
python -m eval.rerank --model v2-int8 --dataset holdout_v3 --sample-frame stratified_session_len --metrics ndcg@10 mrr@10 --seed 42
```
mike: any change in query priming/whitespace? we had a known gap with HTML stripping before
alex.k: queries unchanged. doc layout normalization function was a new PR though: remove_markup + collapse_whitespace. PR 482
julia: can we re-run float32 with same sampleframe to isolate quantization vs docfmt?
alex.k: queued a small float32 run now (job 7821). ETA ~45m
sara: also do quick ablation: keep old doc (with tags) + v2-int8 to see docfmt interaction
mike: +1. add per-slice ndcg by doc_len buckets
alex.k: good call. will post results. cc @ci-bot for job tracking
ci-bot: job 7821 scheduled on runner-gpu-5, logs -> https://ci/internal/7821
sara: if docfmt is culprit maybe revert for canary until we confirm
julia: also check tokenizer boundary shift — earlier tokenization differences caused mrr dips
alex.k: noted. will diff token counts and kv cache alignment
mike: quick thought: if ndcg drop concentrated on long docs, probably formatting truncation or snippet selection
alex.k: ok will slice by doc_len and snippet_len. posting when done :hourglass:
sara: thanks!
alex.k: results: float32 same sampleframe ndcg@10 0.419 (so drop smaller, int8 seems worse), per-slice shows longdocs 0.02 ndcg loss for int8
mike: so quantization amplifies docfmt edgecases
julia: open PR to add guardrails in parser to preserve leading/trailing whitespace in code blocks
alex.k: filed issue #1297. will canary docfmt off for 24h
sara: good plan. update release notes after canary
mike: :thumbsup:
